title: Mystic Figure with Orbs
description: A silhouetted man in a long coat stands centrally, holding two glowing orbs in his outstretched hands. The left orb contains a three-eyed creature while the right shows a tiny figure on a path; behind him is a large geometric circle with occult symbols, a red horizon with a walking figure, and purple hanging star-like shapes above.
prompt: A surreal occult scene featuring a silhouetted man in a long coat standing in the center, holding two glowing purple orbs in his palms. The left orb contains a three-eyed creature and the right orb shows a tiny figure walking on a path. Behind him is a large luminous geometric circle with triangles and occult symbols, a red curved horizon with another walking figure, and purple star-like floral shapes hanging from the top against a black background.
